title: SMOA: Sparse Mixture of Adapters to Mitigate Multiple Dataset Biases

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness using the LLS dataset and IS-CS benchmark to test reliance on spurious correlations between specific words and class labels.

Testing models on adversarial datasets like HARD, PI-CD, and PI-SP to evaluate whether they rely solely on partial input (such as the hypothesis in Natural Language Inference) instead of understanding the full sentence pair.

Evaluating performance on adversarial datasets (HANS, PAWS, APT) and the IS-SD benchmark to measure whether models incorrectly rely on simple lexical or syntactic overlap heuristics to predict entailment or paraphrases.
